# Exploring for Commissioners

Commissioner Service to Exploring Units

Service Teams as well as Commissioners are now providing Unit Service to
Exploring Posts and Exploring Clubs. As a service team member or a
commissioner, it is important for you to know where to find information to
share with your unit.

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2018/01/unit-commissioner.jpg)

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/11/exploring.jpg)

## Exploring Program Resources

The best resource for obtaining information to provide unit service to
Exploring Units is on the [Exploring web site](https://www.exploring.org/),
which provides information about each of the 12 Exploring Career Fields:

  * [Arts & Humanities](https://www.exploring.org/arts-humanities/)
  * [Aviation](https://www.exploring.org/aviation/)
  * [Business](https://www.exploring.org/business/)
  * [Communications](https://www.exploring.org/communications/)
  * [Engineering & Technology](https://www.exploring.org/engineering-technology/)
  * [Fire & EMS](https://www.exploring.org/fire-ems/)

  * [Health Care](https://www.exploring.org/health-care/)
  * [Law & Government](https://www.exploring.org/law-government/)
  * [Law Enforcement](https://www.exploring.org/law-enforcement/)
  * [Science](https://www.exploring.org/science/)
  * [Skilled Trades](https://www.exploring.org/skilled-trades/)
  * [Social Services](https://www.exploring.org/social-services/)

The [Exploring Activity Library](https://www.exploring.org/activity-library/)
provides easy-to-lead activities in all the Exploring career fields and life
skills which can be shared with your Exploring Units.

The Exploring website also provides links to [Exploring-related training
resources](https://www.exploring.org/training-safety/) available in the BSA
Learn Center, including [Youth Protection
Training](https://my.scouting.org/vim2/webscript/output/proxy.aspx?Method=ExecuteScript&ScriptCode=TaleoCourseDeepLinkSSOAgent&Destination=LearnCenter&Origin=Mobile&Program=YPT)
and [Exploring Leader Position-Specific
Training](https://my.scouting.org/vim2/webscript/output/proxy.aspx?Method=ExecuteScript&ScriptCode=TaleoCourseDeepLinkSSOAgent&Destination=LearnCenter&Origin=Mobile&Program=Exploring).

Finally, you will find unit and council resources as well as some useful forms
at the bottom of the Exploring.org home page.
